wargear.name: Shroud-field
wargear.text: A Rangdan officer walks inside a hum of bent light and wrong-coloured shadow, and shots that should strike it slide away. A Model with a Shroud-field has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. This is already included in the Invulnerable Save Characteristic of every Model that has a Shroud-field as standard wargear.

wargear.name: Medusa Shroud
wargear.text: The great Rangdan machines trail the same bent shadow as their officers. A Model with a Medusa Shroud has a 5+ Invulnerable Save against Shooting Attacks.

wargear.name: Skin-thief Cloak
wargear.text: A cloak sewn from the hide of something the Rangda hunted and could not stop admiring; it drinks the light around it. Relic of the Hunt: once per army. The bearer has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dread-mask
wargear.text: The skull of the first Imperial commander its wearer killed, worn where the enemy can see it. Relic of the Hunt: once per army. The bearer increases the value of its Fear (X) Special Rule by 1, to a maximum of Fear (3).

wargear.name: War-moon Beacon
wargear.text: A shard of a war-moon's targeting array, still listening for its masters. Relic of the Hunt: once per army. The bearer may fire a War-moon Strike as if it had the Herald of the War-moon Special Rule. If the bearer is a Hunt-Sovereign, its War-moon Strike has Limited (2) instead of Limited (1).

wargear.name: Collar-key of Advex-Mors
wargear.text: The master key to the collars fitted on the first world the Rangda took. Relic of the Hunt: once per army. The bearer may use the Collar-master Special Rule on a Unit with any Model within 18" of it, and a Unit it Overloads suffers D3-1 wounds at the end of the Phase instead of D3.

wargear.name: Corpse-cloak
wargear.text: Robes woven from the skins of the eaten, which the worms beneath can slide through and out of. The bearer has the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Neural Collar
wargear.text: A band of cold xenos metal sunk into the spine. It carries its masters' will straight into the nerves, and burns through them on command. See the Neural Collars Special Rule.
